guitar.modelsText: Fender Stratocaster (first one in the UK)
models: Fender Stratocaster (first one in the UK)
guitar.notes: Hank Marvin famously owned the first Fender Stratocaster imported to the UK (a salmon-pink/Fiesta Red one), a well-documented and historically significant guitar/guitarist pairing.

tone.target: bright clean instrumental lead with short spring reverb
tone.profile: bright clean instrumental lead with short spring reverb
tone.summary: A pristine signal chain utilizing the US Deluxe and UK Vintage 4x12 to emulate a bright, clean Vox/Fender tone, enhanced by compression and Spring Reverb for that signature Hank Marvin sustain.

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Provide smooth sustain and even out dynamics for lead lines.
Keep the tone clean and pure, avoiding crunch or fuzz.
Emulate the bright, clean Fender/Vox sound required for the classic 60s lead tone.
Provide a classic, bright British cabinet sound that complements the US Deluxe clean tone.
blocks.gap: The ideal choice would be a Fender/Vox specific cab (e.g., 2x12), but UK Vintage 4x12 provides enough brightness and clarity.

blocks.purpose: Enhance the bright top end and clarity of the lead tone.
No wah effect needed for this clean lead tone.
Avoid chorus as per the 'avoid' list.
Avoid delay as per the 'avoid' list.
Provide the required short spring reverb for classic lead tone and sustain.

improvements.summary: Replace the current cabinet IR with a more appropriate Fender/Vox style cab to better match the US Deluxe amp model and classic 60s clean lead tone.

proposals.recommendedAsset: Fender Twin Reverb or Vox AC30 IR
proposals.reason: The current UK Vintage cab clashes with the US Deluxe amp model, losing tonal cohesion for a classic clean lead sound.
